rationale: The approved slice makes Orchestrator consume a bounded secondary-memory profile from its own repository through the already-shipped RepositoryContextHelperProvider. It is additive, reversible, and proves behavior without changing Context Contract schemas, production run-state ownership, queue semantics, or authorization enforcement.

worker_package.objective: Install an Orchestrator-specific repo-centric secondary-memory governance profile and Kit-compatible read-only context helper, then prove RepositoryContextHelperProvider consumes the real repository startup profile without fallback while canonical run, goal, and queue state remain authoritative.
stop_if: A required change falls outside allowed_files.
Implementation requires changing Context Contract v1 schemas or production server behavior.
Project Map working state would become canonical execution, queue, goal, completion, approval, or durable run state.
The helper would write project files, create a persistent index/service, read high-risk paths by default, or expand external/data/runtime scope.
Exact upstream copying beyond the minimal helper and adapted governance contracts becomes necessary without a provenance note.
Publication or redistribution is required and cannot proceed without an explicit license decision.
The same verification failure remains unexplained after two focused attempts.

parallel_safety: One write Worker only; all allowed files form one integration behavior and should not be split.
missing_evidence: No explicit LICENSE or SPDX grant exists in the local Kit tree; retain provenance and do not make a redistribution claim.
